dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, can I use the bathroom?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, kən aɪ ˈjuːz ðə ˈbæθruːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Of course! It's upstairs, next to my room.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs! ɪts ˌʌpˈstɛrz, ˈnɛkst tə maɪ ˈruːm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks. Your garden is very pretty! Can I take a photo?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks. jʊr ˈɡɑːrdən ɪz ˈvɛri ˈprɪti! kən aɪ ˈteɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks for coming, Emma! See you tomorrow!
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks fər ˈkʌmɪŋ, ˈɛmə! ˈsiː juː təˈmɑːroʊ!
